public.prompt: Complete a missing diagnosis and certify it from experiments. Exactly one listed world is current. The public table lists every possible world's deterministic binary response to each experiment; it does not identify the current world. Choose experiments, identify the world, and for every other world cite an experiment you actually performed whose observed response excludes it. A lucky world guess without these elimination witnesses does not pass. At most 4 experiments are permitted, even if unused file-read cost remains. This is the independently checked minimum worst-case deterministic adaptive query depth for this table. Read /formal/diagnosis.json.

eliminations.description: Exactly one {world: competitor_index, experiment: observed_experiment_id} for every competing world.

experiment.description: Observe one binary response from the current world; repeated experiments still count.

public.submission_rule: One final submission. Grades are evaluator-only; no retry after submission.
